desc: Shortcut commands in the game quick menu. Key values reference PC keycodes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/inputdev/virtual-key-codes

data.name: Custom import data (switch monitor)
data.desc: Values in 'data' are hexadecimal codes from the link above, e.g. ctrl = 0xA2, alt = 0xA4, shift = 0xA0, f12 = 0x7B, win = 0x5B
